name: blackrock_depths
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 230 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Needs: Ring of Law arena event (GO_ARENA1-4, GO_ARENA_SPOILS) after Gerstahn
Needs: Tomb of the Seven: gossip with Doomrel (GO_TOMB_ENTER/EXIT, dwarf runes GO_DWARF_RUNE_A01-G01), seven fights
Needs: Shadowforge Key (item 11000) for the Shadowforge gate and the Dark Keeper vaults (GO_SHADOW_LOCK, GO_SHADOW_MECHANISM)
Needs: jail doors and Marshal Windsor escort (optional), Plugger Spazzring keg trap (GO_BAR_KEG_TRAP), golem rooms (GO_GOLEM_ROOM_N/S), throne room door (GO_THRONE_ROOM)
Princess Moira (8929) shares the Emperor's throne room and is friendly (npc_flags questgiver): no leg.

Lava points removed from the pulls (Fireguard Destroyer 8911; the navmesh flags them SLIME from the WMO liquid type and the generator excludes magma and slime, so no run leader route reaches them): leg 5 guid 46268 (849.4 -243.5 -115.9), leg 5 guid 47952 (886.7 -327.9 -116.1), leg 5 guid 48039 (851.7 -281.7 -116.1), leg 5 guid 90736 (932.5 -250.4 -116.3), leg 6 guid 46236 (1022.1 -303.4 -116.4), leg 6 guid 46266 (926.2 -352.4 -116.1), leg 6 guid 47997 (1118.2 -358.5 -120.3), leg 6 guid 90734 (941.0 -310.5 -116.2), leg 7 guid 46245 (1161.9 -315.6 -105.1), leg 7 guid 46267 (1027.7 -246.0 -111.1), leg 7 guid 47995 (1009.7 -235.9 -104.9), leg 7 guid 48037 (1150.9 -323.9 -105.6), leg 7 guid 48040 (1012.2 -239.4 -104.9), leg 7 guid 48090 (1139.2 -241.2 -116.4), leg 7 guid 48091 (1165.1 -327.2 -104.6), leg 7 guid 90729 (983.7 -278.9 -116.4), leg 7 guid 90730 (1154.0 -313.6 -104.3), leg 7 guid 90735 (1067.9 -264.7 -116.4). Leg 7's 'to' is on the Flamelash platform (1046.9 -213.3 -61.7, a map 230 navmesh vertex 45 yd from him), not in the lake.

Pack census and fixes (2026-10-23, PREP-BLACKROCK-DEPTHS): fleers are the entries whose EventAI flees at 15% (command 47: 8890 8892 8894 8895 8903 8916 8920; Marshal 8898's flee event has no action); kill_first the healers and casters (8894 Medic's Prayer of Healing, 8898 Marshal's Holy Light, 8896 Peasant's Heal, 8904 Senator's Fireball/Holy Smite, 8900 Arcanasmith's Arcane Bolt); cc_priority the Mortal Strike Captain 8903, the Kicking Footman 8892, the netting Warden 8890 and the disarming Guardsman 8891, cc_always 8903. The packs that stand at a boss are the boss rows' first: Gerstahn 8912 8890 8921, Grebmar 8921, Angerforge 8901 (his four creature_linking guards), Argelmach 8906 8907, Fineous 8897 8905. The rares Loregrain 9024, Stilgiss 9041, Verek 9042 and the patrolling Panzor 8923 and Roccor 9025 are pull groups of their own (they stood 3-13 yd inside a pack's radius; Panzor and Roccor carry their creature_movement paths). Every pull is capped at 8 units (was up to 34 in the Magmus leg) and its radius is its own spread + 5 yd (wander), so a row no longer reaches the next pack; see the prep note for the pack table and the r12-style risks left in.
